_comment: Seed data for BlockBook Phase 1. Parsed from the original Notepad file. Rows with NEEDS REVIEW in notes are genuinely ambiguous in the source and must be resolved in-game - see docs/09-TESTING-QA.md section 8. All scaled figures here use Math.floor, matching docs/07-ALGORITHMS.md.

locations.name: Home
locations.notes: Scales to nether 27 / 46. NOTE: the overworld-side nether portal at Home is not yet recorded as its own location - see PRD open question Q7. Until it is, link health for Home Portal is measured against the base, not the portal.

locations.name: Home Portal (Nether side)
locations.notes: Scales to overworld 128 / 304. Home is at 221 / 374 -> nether 27 / 46, which is 13.60 nether blocks away (forward direction, tight). Backward direction is 116.40 overworld blocks - loose. Overall health: LOOSE. The BUILD_PLAN figure of 14.5 was arithmetically off; hypot(11, 8) = 13.60.

locations.name: Portal @ 631 / 245
locations.notes: NEEDS REVIEW. Scales to nether 78 / 30. Home Portal (Nether side) is at 16 / 38 = 62.51 blocks away, INSIDE the 128 link radius. This portal very likely links to Home Portal rather than creating a new one. VERIFY BY WALKING THROUGH IT - this is the app's flagship correctness test (docs/09-TESTING-QA.md R1).

locations.name: Portal @ -495 / -394
locations.notes: NEEDS REVIEW - dimension is a guess. Was written on the same line as 631 / 67 / 245 but they are NOT a pair: floor(631/8) = 78, not -495. If this is nether, the overworld side is ~ -3960 / -3152. Visit it and confirm the dimension (PRD Q1).

locations.name: Unlabelled 2411
locations.notes: NEEDS REVIEW - no label in the original notes. Y = 22 suggests a cave or mine. Visit and name it (PRD Q2).

locations.name: Shipwreck (near monument)
locations.notes: Ocean monument nearby - get exact coordinates next visit (PRD Q4). This note is the only way the monument is currently findable, which is why search must cover notes.

locations.name: Spider Spawner
locations.notes: Cobweb source for Potion of Weaving.

locations.name: Bastion Portal (Overworld side)
locations.notes: Scales to nether 86 / -241. NOTE: BUILD_PLAN said -240; floor(-1926/8) = floor(-240.75) = -241. Math.floor, not truncation. No link conflicts - nearest nether portal is 287.7 blocks away. Nether-side portal not yet recorded.

locations.name: Trial Chamber Portal (Overworld)
locations.notes: Scales to nether 277 / -503. Paired with Fortress Portal (Nether). Forward 4.12 blocks (tight), backward 33.24 blocks (loose). Overall health: LOOSE - a new overworld portal within 128 blocks of 2208 / -4056 would steal the return trip.

locations.name: Fortress Portal (Nether)
locations.notes: Scales to overworld 2208 / -4056. Paired with Trial Chamber Portal. VERIFIED GOOD PAIR - links correctly in both directions. Blaze rod source.
